title: Sr. Software Engineer - Observability
description: P-1394 Sr. Software Engineer (L5) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Observability team, you will develop solutions that provide critical insights into the health and performance of one of the world's largest-scale software platforms. Our fleet consists of millions of virtual machines generating terabytes of logs and processing exabytes of data daily. You will build the tooling and infrastructure that enables engineers across Databricks to monitor, debug, and optimize systems at massive scale. The Impact You Will Have - Build scalable observability infrastructure for metrics collection, aggregation, storage, and visualization across distributed systems - Establish standards and best practices for logging, metrics, and tracing that enable engineers to effectively monitor system health and performance - Collaborate with engineering teams to identify and implement key observability signals for critical platform components - Ensure the reliability and performance of observability systems by contributing to technical roadmap planning and execution - Optimize observability platform costs through improved resource utilization, retention policies, and query efficiency - Participate in on-call rotations and reduce incident response times to maintain operational excellence What We Look For - 5+ years of software engineering experience - Experience with one or more programming languages including Python, Java, Scala, or C++ - Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments - Experience with observability tools and practices including metrics collection, health monitoring, and distributed tracing - Strong understanding of system performance, reliability, and scalability principles - Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and communicate technical concepts clearly - B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.
